svg.title: Coordinate count p is the same block’s tubular census, and M is its actual covariance bound. Its address census is the sum of the fine plaquette types, two coarse bond types, coarse and fine site types, and fine-link itinerary types. The warning threshold is ξtfield/g, g = β−1/2, with tfield/g ≥ P/2 for fine monitor P. Put ε = ξ/4 and H = ε √ P.
